unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We use I'll when we've just decided to do something.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: di（弟）+ cide（切开）：弟弟下定决心把苹果切开。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: When we say 'I'll do something', we announce our decision.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: an（一个）+ ounce（盎司）：大声宣布得了一盎司黄金。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Did you call Max? Oh no, I forgot.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: for（为了）+ get（得到）：为了得到新东西，却把旧的给忘了。
hun（洪）+ gry（干力气活）：洪金宝干完活肚子饿了。
hea（黑）+ vy（威力）：黑金刚力气大，搬得动重的箱子。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Thanks for lending me the money.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l + end（结尾）：借钱有期限，到了结尾要还。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I won't tell anyone what happened. I promise.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: pro（向前）+ mise（米老鼠）：米老鼠向前保证一定守信用。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We use won't to say that somebody refuses to do something.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: re（重新）+ fuse（熔断）：电路拒绝通电，直接熔断了。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm going on holiday next Saturday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: hol（好）+ i + day（天）：好开心的一天，放假了。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We use shall I ...? / shall we ...? to ask if it's OK to do something or to ask for a suggestion.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sug（死个）+ ges（鸽子）+ tion（名词后缀）：提出建议把鸽子放飞。
